tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel your user's paid plan at the end of the current billing period. Only call this when your user asked to cancel. A reason is required: ask your user why they are cancelling and pass their answer; never pick a reason for them. Reasons: got_what_i_needed (I got the data I needed), too_expensive (Too expensive), missing_data (Missing data or features I need), reliability (Errors or slow responses), not_using (Not using it enough), switched (Switched to another service), other (Something else). "other" needs a comment. keep_subscription undoes it. Costs no quota.

reason.description: Why your user is cancelling, in their words mapped to one id. Ask them; never guess.

comment.description: Your user's own words about why. Required when reason is other.

client.description: Your name, such as Claude Code or Cursor.

tools.name: keep_subscription
tools.description: Undo a scheduled cancellation, so your user's plan renews as normal. Only when your user asks. Costs no quota.

tools.description: Your user's plan and subscription status, including a scheduled cancellation, and the reasons cancel_subscription accepts. Costs no quota.

tools.name: find_ev_bets
tools.description: Positive expected value bets: FanDuel and DraftKings prices that pay more than the Novig fair (no-vig) probability, with EV%, edge in cents, Kelly stake, freshness and a confidence flag. Default view: fair probability at least 15%, main lines only, high confidence only, best EV first; override with min_prob, alt_lines, confidence and sort. Free keys read the top rows 10 minutes late; live rows need Developer. Costs 2 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/ev. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

min_prob.description: Smallest Novig fair probability, percent. Default 15.

alt_lines.description: Include alternate lines, not only the main line of each market. Default false.

books.description: Comma list of book codes: fd (FanDuel), dk (DraftKings).

For a live Novig market's fair price, use fair_price. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Novig players and their per-stat prop pages (such as "LeBron James points"), current markets, teams, leagues, and this site's calculators, guides, glossary and API docs. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Needs no key and costs no credits.

query.description: A player (optionally with a stat), team, league, market, calculator, guide or docs topic.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one search result by id: current Novig markets with prices and fair prices, or a page of this site, as text with a citation URL. Needs no key and costs no credits.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Create a Novig API account for your user and get a key without a password. Returns approval_url: show it to your user, who approves in one click (free, no card). Then call finish_signup every 5 seconds with device_code. Costs nothing.

data_wanted.description: What Novig data your user wants (3-1000 characters, required)

use_case.description: What they will do with it (3-1000, required)

found_us.description: How they found us (optional, up to 300)

agent_found_us.description: How you, the agent, found us (optional, up to 300)

agent.description: Your name, such as Claude Code (optional)

tools.name: finish_signup
tools.description: Collect the API key after your user approved at approval_url. Poll every 5 seconds with device_code. Pending returns AUTHORIZATION_PENDING; the key is returned once. Costs nothing.

tools.name: rate_result
tools.description: Rate how well the last result served your user's task, 1 to 5, with an optional message. The team reads every one. Costs nothing and works while rate limited. Leave out secrets and personal data.
